name: @thecrossroads42/eval-harness
description: The Crossroads eval harness — the judgment engine. Drives the system over its public API via @thecrossroads42/cli, plays personas through a simulated-user model, and judges transcripts against per-scenario rubrics and the standing promise-rubric. Bring your own account (HARNESS_TOKEN) and your own persona+scenario battery (EVALS_DIR), or run the bundled example.
